description:
Delete the archive readers that found prior executions in the event log, including the file backend's second parser.

## Background

Archive preview and execute read prior executions from per-target evidence records. Left over: `IssueStore::read_artifact_archive_events` (`crates/jit/src/storage/mod.rs:245-256`) and its file-backend override (`storage/json.rs:1328-1364`), a second event-log parser with its own torn-prefix rule (`is_torn_event_prefix`, `:1566`) and a raw `"artifact_archive_executed"` literal; and the command tests that call the reader directly (`commands/archive.rs:1050-2226`, including `test_archive_event_reader_accepts_final_and_multiple_nested_brace_torn_prefixes` at `:1298`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `read_artifact_archive_events` and `is_torn_event_prefix` no longer exist, and no test calls them.
- [hard] REQ-02: No event-log parser exists outside `domain::parse_known_events`.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: Archive event-log readers are gone
